svg.title: UML class diagram for AI Cost Autopilot
svg.desc: The gateway module owns one CodeTrimmer, one SemanticCache, one Autopilot and one Metrics instance, and depends on the provider, config and benchmarks modules. The three concrete components structurally implement the frozen Trimmer, Cache and Autopilot protocols from gateway/interfaces.py. Autopilot owns a SecretsDetector, SemanticCache holds cache entries and Metrics holds up to 30 recent entries.
svg.text: Python backend in code/. Names, signatures and visibility match the source; plain dicts and module-level functions are shown as stereotyped classifiers.
+ collapse_python(source: str, keep: set[str] | None): str
+ build_call_graph(source: str, known: set[str] | None): dict
+ expand_focus(focus: set, graph: dict, hops: int = 2): set
Data shapes passed between classes (plain dicts, not classes)
composition: owner holds the part for its lifetime

The gateway uses the concrete classes directly and never imports gateway/interfaces.py; the components match those protocols by shape. The dashboards reach the gateway only over HTTP, so they appear in the sequence and deployment diagrams.
